name: asc-whats-new-writer
activation: `command -v asc` succeeds, `asc auth status --validate` passes, and the user confirms a paid Apple Developer Program account.
prerequisites: Drafting and localizing (phases 1-3) need no asc when the user supplies keywords.
Uploading needs a paid Apple Developer Program account and asc with an App Store Connect API key.
risks: Uploads release notes and promotional text after approval (SKILL.md:143-145).
errata: Overstates promotional text as the only field editable without a new submission.
